newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Winbond up on T$3 bln fire loss claim.
newsitem.headline: Winbond up on T$3 bln fire loss claim.

text.p: Winbond Electronics Corp, one of Taiwan's leading semiconductor makers, rose at mid-morning on Wednesday after it said it had gained T$3.03 billion in insurance compensation for fire losses that occurred in October 1996.

"Nine co-insurance firms have agreed to pay Winbond fire insurance compensation worth T$3.03 billion, a fund that will help us rebuild our plant," Hander Chang, Winbond spokesman and assistant vice-president, told Reuters.
After 60 minutes, at 0200 GMT, Winbond rose T$1 or 2.47 percent to T$41.6, while the overall index was up 0.51 percent.
Brokers said the fund should help improve Winbond's financial performance.
"The results are better than expected because previously the nine co-insurance firms were unwilling to conpensate Winbond," said National Securities analyst Oliver Fang.
